figurative_meaning_bn: তুচ্ছ; ঘৃণ্য নীচ নোংরামনের লোক - গালিবিশেষ
figurative_meaning_en: Trivial; despicable, lowly, dirty person - a special slur
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা ছুঁচো, কখনো বিশ্বাস করিস না।
এই ছুঁচোরা লোকের সাথে মিশিস না।
example_sentences_in_english: He's a dirty rat, never trust him.
Don't mix with these lowlife scum.
note: The idiom draws from the cultural view of rats as filthy and treacherous creatures in Bengali folklore.
